risks.risk: Axle shafts may not be included (or may be different quantity/condition than claimed).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing both axle shafts clearly laid out (full length, both ends/boots visible) and confirm quantity.
risks.if_unproven: Price as steering rack/gear + radiator/condenser only (axle shafts treated as not included).

risks.risk: Radiator vs A/C condenser is unclear; also may be damaged/leaking or missing end tanks/hoses.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the label/part markings (if any) and both end tanks, plus a quick leak test video or evidence of intact fittings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as damaged/unknown condition radiator/condenser (for parts only).

risks.risk: Steering rack/gear may be seized, leaking, or missing components (boots, tie-rod ends, mounting brackets).
risks.proof: Ask for close-ups of both ends (tie-rod ends), boot condition, and any visible part numbers; also a video showing the rack movement by hand.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-working/for parts only steering rack/gear (unknown internal condition).

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: parts may not match the buyer’s vehicle (make/model/engine/steering type).
risks.proof: Ask for the donor vehicle details (make/model/year) or any stamped part numbers on the rack and radiator/condenser.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case compatibility (assume buyer may need to adapt; treat as scrap/parts value).

proof_requests: Photos of the two drive shafts/axle shafts (both pieces) showing full length and both ends/boots.
Close-up photos of steering rack/gear ends and any markings/part numbers; include a short video of the rack moving by hand.
Close-up photos of radiator/condenser end tanks and any markings; confirm whether it’s radiator or A/C condenser.
Donor vehicle details (make/model/year) or stamped part numbers for compatibility.
response.reason: From photo 0, the steering rack/gear and radiator/condenser are visible, but the claimed two drive shafts are not shown and the functional/compatibility condition is unknown. Missing proof prevents a confident worst-case price for the full bundle.
